cats.name: Mariposa
cats.bio: Meet Mariposa! Mariposa is an adorable 2-month-old girl with a big personality and a mischievous streak! This playful little troublemaker is often the first to lead her siblings into their next adventure. Whether she's discovering new places to explore or finding creative ways to entertain herself (and occasionally redecorate with paper towels!), Mariposa is always keeping everyone on their toes. She's looking for a fun-loving family who will embrace her playful spirit and provide plenty of toys, enrichment, and love! I may be able to live with other cats and/or dogs. I may be able to live with children. Please email your completed adoption application to adoption@cochranehumane.ca.

cats.name: Packer
cats.bio: *I am in a foster home. Meet Packer: a gorgeous little mini-panther who perfectly balances a confident playful spirit with a sweet, gentle side. Packer absolutely loves wand toys and will leap, chase, and stalk them with expert precision. She can usually be found wrestling and tumbling with her siblings. She has a fantastic playful energy and sweet nature. Packer is looking for a patient human who understands there’s a time to cuddle and a time to play and she gets to choose. She isn't a kitty you can force into your lap, but when she decides it is cuddle time, it makes the moment feel incredibly special. Packer will melt your heart with the sweetest, softest meow you have ever heard! If you have a patient heart and are ready to earn the love of a truly special girl, Packer will reward you with her soft meows, choosing-you cuddles, and a lifetime of devotion. Littermates: Little Bit, Radioactive, Binary, Bulldozer

cats.name: Shorty
cats.bio: Meet Shorty! Shorty is an adorable 3-month-old girl with a gentle heart who's slowly discovering that humans can be pretty wonderful! This sweet little kitten is still shy, but thanks to the patience and kindness of her foster family, she's beginning to enjoy gentle pets, has discovered the joys of purring, and has even allowed herself to be picked up! Shorty is looking for a calm, patient family who will give her the time and space she needs to continue building her confidence. With a little love, understanding, and plenty of encouragement, this sweet girl has all the potential to blossom into a wonderful companion! I may be able to live with other cats and/or dogs. I may be able to live with children. Please email your completed adoption application to adoption@cochranehumane.ca.

cats.name: Toffee
cats.bio: Meet Toffee! Meet Toffee, an adorable 3-month-old kitten with a sweet little face that's sure to melt your heart! At this age, the world is full of exciting things to discover, and Toffee has plenty of growing, playing, and exploring ahead of her. She's looking for a loving family who can provide lots of patience, playtime, and affection as she grows into her personality. If you're looking to add a little sweetness to your life, Toffee might be your perfect match! ❤️ I might be able to live with other cats and/or dogs. I might be able to live with children. Email the filled-out adoption form to: adoption@cochranehumane.ca

cats.name: Molly Malone
cats.bio: *I am in a foster home. Molly Malone may be one of the smallest kittens in the litter, but she's certainly not short on curiosity! Just like her famous Irish namesake, this little girl likes to be out and about, seeing what's happening. She's usually the first to check out anything new, and if there's a toy involved, even better! Molly loves to play and is always ready for a little adventure. But she's not all go, go, go. When she's had enough excitement, she's quite happy to climb into your lap and settle in for a cuddle. She's a sweet little mix of curiosity, playfulness and affection, with just enough mischief to keep life interesting! Littermates: Rory McIlroy, Seamus Finnigan, Puca, Fionn McCool, Gracie O'Malley

cats.name: Pepper
cats.bio:
Peppy little Pepper is the softest and fuzziest of felines. Despite still being easily startled, she loves being held and petted by her foster mom and falling asleep on her lap. Known for her purr, she also loves playing with toys, chasing her sisters through the cat tunnel and exploring her environment. Highly food motivated and fully litter box trained, Pepper will perk up any adoring adoptive home. Purr-haps yours?

Pepper was born approximately August 2026.

cats.name: Gracie O'Malley
cats.bio: *I am in a foster home. Named after Ireland's famous Pirate Queen, our little Gracie isn't quite the fearless adventurer you might expect! She's a bit of a chicken, but we prefer to think of her as a careful thinker. Anything new or unusual requires a thorough investigation, and watching her figure things out is absolutely hilarious! When it comes to people, though, Gracie doesn't hesitate. She's a real sweetheart who seeks out human company and loves a comfortable lap. She's also a champion biscuit maker, happily kneading away while soaking up affection. Gracie may not be ready to sail the seven seas, but she's more than ready for a forever home with a comfy lap, plenty of love and a steady supply of biscuits! Littermates: Molly Malone, Rory McIlroy, Seamus Finnigan, Puca, Fionn McCool

cats.name: North Carolina
cats.bio: These two sweet southern belles South Caroline and North Carolina bring full-on silliness and charm to your Living room. Fueled with chaos these three are ready to provide life long entertainment and companionship. They will fill your heart with sunshine just like the states they are named after. We do encourage that kittens get adopted together but this is not mandatory and can go home solo if you so choose. They can't wait to meet you!
